FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 236
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/26/2023
Senate Bill 236 as introduced would increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
Alabama State Council on the Arts by an undetermined amount to commission the design,
construction, and the placement of a life-size statue of civil rights leader Representative John
Lewis. However, this increased financial obligations of the Council could be offset by an
undetermined amount provided that public or private gifts, grants, and donations, including
in-kind services, and funds are made available to the Council and by the Legislature if
necessary.
